reviewItem.question: Does "Ignoring status field from differences by default: By default, the compare options to ignore the status field has been changed from `crd` to `all` resources" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=resource.compareoptions|component=argocd-cm (value-changed)?

proposed.statement: By default, Argo CD's compare options to ignore the status field changed from applying to 'crd' (custom resources) to 'all' resource types, meaning status field differences are no longer detected unless explicitly configured.
